hotels.name: Hyatt on the Bund, Shanghai
hotels.bed: Queen / King (Deluxe Bund Suite River View Double Bed: 1 Queen bed, 80 m²; Club River View Room Double Bed: 1 Queen bed, 42–45 m²)
hotels.bathroom: Private bathroom — separate bathtub + shower, rainfall showerhead, bathrobes, slippers
hotels.amenities: Spa, indoor pool, hot tub, sauna, 6 restaurants/bars (incl. VUE Bar), fitness centre, free Wi-Fi, concierge, airport pick-up
hotels.metro: Line 2/10 East Nanjing Road; Line 10/14 Yuyuan Garden (walk)
hotels.michelin_note: Highest density: Huangpu holds the largest share of Shanghai's 51 starred restaurants (Canton 8, T'ang Court, Bao Li Xuan, Imperial Treasure, etc.) — most within 15–30 min metro.
hotels.proxy_note: From CNY 1,109/night listing (hyatt-onthebund-shanghai.h-rez.com, accessed 2026-11-25). Proxy only.

hotels.name: The Peninsula Shanghai
hotels.address: 32 Zhongshan Dong Yi Lu, Huangpu, Shanghai
hotels.bed: King (Deluxe Room: 1 king or 2 twin beds, pillow-top mattress; suites: king)
hotels.bathroom: Private marble bathroom — oversize bathtub with spa jets + TV, separate walk-in shower, double basins, dressing room
hotels.amenities: Peninsula Spa by ESPA, indoor pool, 5 restaurants/bars, Peninsula Arcade (25+ brands), butler service, BMW/Rolls-Royce transfers, 24h in-room dining
hotels.michelin_note: Bund location — same Huangpu cluster as Hyatt on the Bund; marginally fewer walkable starred venues than #1.
